questions.question: A prophecy says many were appalled at the LORD's suffering Servant. What was His appearance like?

answers.text: Disfigured beyond that of any man
Bright like the face of an angel
Dressed like a king on his throne

questions.question: A prophecy says all people have gone astray like sheep. What does the LORD do with the wrong of all of them?

answers.text: He lays it all on His Servant
He leaves each one to carry it
He sends it away with the sheep

questions.question: A prophecy says the LORD's Servant stayed silent while He was oppressed. Which animal is He compared to?

answers.text: A lamb led to the slaughter
A goat sent into the wilderness
A ram caught in a thicket

questions.question: The LORD calls His suffering Servant righteous. What will this Servant do for many people?

answers.text: Make them right and carry their sins
Judge them and send them away
Teach them and then leave them
